sloka: किमेतदिच्छेयमहं श्रोतुं प्रव्याहृतं त्वया ।यस्मात्त्वमागतो देशमिमं चीरजटाजिनी ॥ २.१०४.२॥
transliteration: kimetadiccheyamahaṁ śrotuṁ pravyāhṛtaṁ tvayā ।yasmāttvamāgato deśamimaṁ cīrajaṭājinī ॥ 2.104.2॥

translations.english: I want to hear what brought you to this region with your barkrobes, matted locks and antelope skin.
